title: Online Car Dealership: Hong Kong deep edition

questions.q: In "Read your local market Understand", which of these is a key idea?
o: A dense, trade-led city. Space is costly, so online and shared-space models fit well.
Build trust with full photos, a clear condition report and a short return window.
Calculate the margin per car: buy price, repair, listing and delivery costs, and sale price.
Check against a worse case: if sales are 25% lower, do you still cover costs?

questions.q: In "Choose your sector Analyse", which of these is a key idea?
o: Cluster A, Online selling and marketing: Strong fit: customers shop on phones and expect delivery within a day. Compete on speed and service, not price.
Payments: bank transfer and fast-payment apps first; give an instant receipt.
Add tax and duty explicitly; never bury them in a price. Check with a local expert.
One measure per week: enquiries, orders or revenue; pick one.
